title: Question-specific peer independence and directional support matrix
mode: primary-source web research and plan-only update
scope: Broaden open-source DWG/DXF route inventory across codec, projection, converter, and consumer layers
Distinguish parser ancestry, specification lineage, fixture provenance, expected-value authorship, and downstream kernel/consumer lineage
Refine direction/version/entity/carrier evidence admission and optional comparator selection
Preserve implementation speed, local fixture provenance, and deferred external gates

method.kind: Read-only review of primary project repositories, official documentation, published support matrices, and the current local plan
method.limitations: Most project default-branch pages and issue indexes are mutable source statements, not artifact-level runtime evidence. No peer source/package was pinned or executed and no sample was independently opened. The review refines evidence selection and does not establish a new libdxfrw defect or promote support.

sources.revision: Mutable project manual, CLI documentation, and repository inventory reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The project documents broad DWG/DXF support, ongoing coverage and class maturity distinctions, structured reader diagnostics, corpus testing, and fuzz entry points. Broad coverage statements and same-library rewrite/re-read are not independent semantic proof.

sources.revision: Mutable README/version matrix, reader example, and issue index reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: Published reader/writer capabilities are direction- and version-specific; the reader exposes notifications. A successful document return or matrix mark does not establish per-record retention, graph closure, or 3D semantics.

sources.revision: Mutable README and measured corpus table reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The project labels itself pre-alpha, publishes decoded/skipped/errored counts over its own sample set, states its implementation is based on the ODA specification, reports one algorithm cross-check against ACadSharp documentation, and explicitly disclaims external CAD acceptance for its experimental writer.

sources.revision: Stable documentation and mutable source reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: ezdxf is a DXF route; its entity source says version override does not convert unsupported features and those may be ignored. Its ACIS path provides carrier handling and a limited flat-face projection, not a general ACIS kernel.
The README declares R10-R2014 DXF read/write with named missing entity families and warns that some typed writer output may not open in AutoCAD.

sources.revision: Current public driver docs, source wrapper, and documentation page reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: GDAL is a constrained OGR projection/carrier route. Stock FreeCAD composes an external DWG-to-DXF converter with a selected DXF importer and documents that its stock DXF path does not read embedded ACIS solids.

The DWG path uses vendored LibreDWG through FFI, the DXF path uses undxf, and the current output is a model/JSON/render route rather than DWG/DXF writing; its DWG results are not a second LibreDWG parser vote.

sources.revision: Mutable fork README and specification reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The project identifies as a fork of original SourceForge libdxfrw, lists tests and points to an external fess-testdata corpus. Its sibling-fork ancestry and unbound test inputs mean it can suggest code/test discovery targets but cannot count as independent parser evidence or authorize fixture import.

assessment.planImpact: Adds a question-specific independence tuple and a version/direction/entity/owner/carrier/disposition match key to the existing optional-peer admission gate, plus a low-cost evidence ordering. Correlated wrappers and forks are attributed to their parser lineage. No new defect, implementation slice, peer run, required validation, or support claim is introduced.

implementationReadyChecks: Choose an existing local owner and exact overlap key before selecting an optional peer; do not start from a broad feature-matrix claim.
Record parser ancestry, shared specification/algorithm basis, producer/input provenance, expected-value authorship, projection path, and kernel/native consumer separately for that question.
Prefer source/API review and locally generated controls; execute at most one exact-pinned comparator at the existing composed boundary when it can resolve a named uncertainty.
Collect per-handle source dispositions and diagnostics, and separate parse, write, independent reopen, geometric semantics, and native acceptance outcomes.
If artifact identity, route, input mode, or independent expectations cannot be bound promptly, record NOT_RUN and continue local fast implementation.
Keep one focused local selector/owning CTest per slice, local-generated-only committed fixture policy, existing broader-suite cadence, and all six external J items DEFERRED_EXTERNAL.
